name: fix-field-value-syntax
body: source: 'Field types: text (inline Markdown), number, date …; max_length counted on stripped text'; inconsistency: input syntax for number/date values, the inline Markdown rules for text, link validation inside text, and how max_length counts were undefined (feedback-4); resolution: `date` values written `YYYY-MM-DD`; `number` values are plain YAML numbers (e.g. 1250000, 0.12), strings = type error; text inline Markdown follows body inline rules and its `[]()` links are validated exactly like body links (#label must exist); max_length counts characters after Markdown is stripped — written into field-types, field-rules, number-date-formats, domain.value.field-type and domain.value.field [with user]
